successors.name: British Cape Colony
successors.text: Thembuland 'between Umtata and the Tsomo River' at the completion of annexation in 1885

ledger.x: c. 1650: the Thembu kingdom stands in Thembuland. The page says only that the Thembu federation was established 'around the 16th century'; 1650 is the map's start year, not a dated founding.
1885: annexation of Thembuland to the Cape Colony is completed, with about 60,000 people.
1885: the independent Thembu kingdom ends with the completed annexation.

certainty.note: Page gives rough extent and no dated frontier changes.
